units.hand_m: m above the nearest drainage (ASF GLO-30 HAND, 30 m)
units.slope_deg: degrees, from the elevation on the 20 m grid
units.s1_wet_freq: share of the passes up to the issue pass (never one from the held-out window) that saw water here
units.soil_moisture: m3/m3, newest NISAR SME2 map before the issue day (200 m, provisional)
units.target_is_nisar: 1 when the water map to predict is NISAR's, 0 for Sentinel-1: the two radars see different water
units.prev_is_nisar: 1 where the previous water map is NISAR's
units.soil_moisture_age_d: days from that map to the target
units.soil_moisture_missing: 1 where there is no such map
units.rain_prior_7d_mm: mm in the 7 days before the issue day
units.rain_prior_30d_mm: mm in the 30 days before the issue day
units.rain_between_mm: mm from the issue day to the day before the target
units.rain_between_max1d_mm: wettest day of that interval, mm
units.days_since_rain_peak: days from that wettest day to the target
units.lead_days: days from the issue pass to the target
units.prev_water: 1 water, 0 dry at the latest pass up to the issue pass
units.prev_water_age_d: days from that observation to the target

target: water (DSWx-S1 class 1 or 3) at the target pass; 0 = class 0; other classes are not used

timing.rule: issue pass = latest pass at least min_lead_days before the target; rain 'between' is realized rain in fits and replays
